"Create a retro-style **2D platformer** inspired by the original Mario, playable locally on a computer. Use **basic shapes** for characters and obstacles while maintaining a visually appealing retro aesthetic. The game should feature a **coin system**, ensuring coins do not overlap with obstacles.  

Include a **menu UI** where players can **select their character** from different basic shapes and choose the **starting world (from World 1 to World 5)**, with increasing difficulty as they progress. The **default game speed** should feel smooth, and players should be able to **move forward and jump at the same time**.  

Players can use **both the up and down arrow keys for a big jump**. When the character **touches an obstacle**, they should be **pushed back**, but there should be **no health system**. The background, UI, and coins should fit the retro theme. Add an **instruction bar** in the menu to guide players. Ensure smooth gameplay with no overlapping of coins and obstacles."
